role: Runtime A — native/reference EXL3 execution path
commit_verification: git clone turboderp-org/exllamav3 && git checkout d3739fd && git rev-parse HEAD; also refs/tags/v1.5.3 dereferences to the same commit
install_method: upstream prebuilt wheel exllamav3-1.5.3+cu128.torch2.10.0-cp312-cp312-linux_x86_64.whl from the GitHub release page for tag v1.5.3 (chosen because it exactly matches the VM's Python 3.12 / CUDA 12.8 stack; the pinned tag and the installed artifact are the same revision)
effective_cli_command: python -m benchmarks run <suite> --runtime exllamav3 --tokenizer hf:ewin-reg/MiniCPM5-2B-EXL3-Quantized@e36fbb568f466739d7c244a5100d01acf93d3b7f --model ewin-reg/MiniCPM5-2B-EXL3-Quantized --model-revision e36fbb568f466739d7c244a5100d01acf93d3b7f --quantization EXL3 --bpw 4.0 --runtime-config '<json>'

runtime_flags.greedy_sampler: ArgmaxSampler (explicit; Job default is stochastic MinP0.08/temp0.8)

normal_optimizations.cuda_graphs: disabled — v1.5.3 has no CUDA-graph capture path
normal_optimizations.speculative_decoding: disabled (no draft model available for this checkpoint)

exl3_authenticity.verdict: genuine EXL3 execution; no silent dequantization

dependency_lockfile: environments/exllamav3.pip-freeze.txt (uv pip freeze, 64 packages, includes the exact wheel URL)
